Werde Teil eines starken Teams bei emetriq!

emetriq, Teil der Deutschen Telekom AG, bietet datengetriebene Online-Advertising-Lösungen und setzt sich für fairen Datenzugang als Treibstoff für Innovation und Vielfalt ein. Mit unserer Expertise und Technologiekompetenz steigern wir die Präzision und Relevanz von Online-Werbung. Als Initiatoren des größten kollaborativen Datenpools in Deutschland vereinen wir über 100 Data- und Mediaexperten.

Im Team Magenta fungieren wir zudem als exklusive Programmatic & Paid Social Media Agentur für die Deutsche Telekom. Von Awareness bis Performance: Wir entwickeln digitale Mediapläne und steuern Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Marketing Funnels.

Zur Unterstützung dieses Agenturteams suchen wir ab sofort einen Senior Strategischen Account Manager Digital (m/w/d) in Festanstellung. In dieser Funktion betreust du unsere größten Kunden - unterschiedlichste Geschäftsbereiche der Deutschen Telekom Gruppe - als erster Ansprechpartner für programmatische Werbekampagnen.


Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Strategische Kundenbetreuung und Beratung:
    Du bist zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen einem Geschäftsbereich der Telekom und deinem Team bei emetriq. Dabei betreust du bestehende Kundenaccounts ganzheitlich, baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter. Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, identifizierst neue Wachstumschancen und berätst Kund:innen proaktiv zu digitalen Marketing- und Media-Strategien

  • Strategische Entwicklung und Innovation:
    Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und internen Teams kanalübergreifende Strategien und Maßnahmenpläne für digitale Kampagnen. Dabei bringst du Marktkenntnis, Innovationsgeist und ein tiefes Verständnis für programmatische Werbung, Paid Social und datengetriebene Marketingansätze ein – insbesondere im Kontext cookieloser Technologien und neuer Targeting-Ansätze

  • Projekt- und Stakeholdermanagement:
    Du steuerst komplexe Projekte eigenverantwortlich und koordinierst interne Teams, externe Partner:innen sowie unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf Kundenseite. Dabei sorgst du für reibungslose Abläufe, klare Prioritäten und die Einhaltung von Timings, Budgets und Qualitätsstandards

  • Kampagnen- und Maßnahmensteuerung:
    Du begleitest Kampagnen und strategische Initiativen von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Gemeinsam mit den Performance-Teams stellst du sicher, dass Maßnahmen effizient umgesetzt und kontinuierlich optimiert werden

  • Beratung auf Management-Ebene:
    Du bereitest strategische Präsentationen, Entscheidungsgrundlagen und Workshops auf und führst eigenständig Kundentermine sowie Abstimmungen mit unterschiedlichen Hierarchieebenen durch. Dabei trittst du als souveräne:r Berater:in und Sparringspartner:in auf

  • Zusammenarbeit und Wissenstransfer:
    Du arbeitest eng mit internen Fachbereichen zusammen, identifizierst übergreifende Themen und treibst den Austausch von Best Practices sowie strategischen Learnings innerhalb des Teams aktiv voran


Was du mitbringst

  • Berufserfahrung:
    Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Account Management, Consulting oder in einer vergleichbaren Position innerhalb der digitalen Medien- oder Marketingbranche. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im Umfeld von Programmatic Advertising, Paid Social oder datengetriebenem Marketing mit

  • Strategisches Denken:
    Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für digitale Geschäftsmodelle, Marktmechanismen und Kundenbedürfnisse. Es fällt dir leicht, komplexe Anforderungen in strategische Konzepte und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen zu übersetzen

  • Kunden- und Beratungsverständnis:
    Du überzeugst durch ein sicheres Auftreten, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und ein gutes Gespür für unterschiedliche Stakeholder. Dabei agierst du auf Augenhöhe mit Kund:innen und kannst sowohl beraten als auch konstruktiv challengen

  • Projektmanagement und Eigenverantwortung:
    Du behältst auch in komplexen Projekten den Überblick, arbeitest strukturiert und steuerst Themen eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg

  • Präsentations- und Kommunikationsskills:
    Du bist erfahren in der Erstellung von Präsentationen und in der Durchführung von Workshops sowie Terminen auf Management-Ebene

  • Analytisches und technisches Verständnis:
    Du interessierst dich für digitale Trends, technische Zusammenhänge und datenbasierte Marketingansätze und kannst daraus relevante Impulse ableiten

  • Sprachkompetenz:
    Du kommunizierst sicher und professionell auf Deutsch und Englisch

Was uns besonders macht

Wir bei emetriq sind ein Team aus Experten, die gemeinsam wachsen und das Unternehmen voranbringen möchten. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf Vertrauen, Agilität, Selbstorganisation und Eigenverantwortung – ohne starre Hierarchien, aber mit klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven. Mut zur Veränderung, Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit prägen unsere Kultur.

Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Leidenschaft für Daten und Innovation teilen. Perfektion ist nicht unser Ziel, aber Engagement und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung – Schritt für Schritt.

Unsere Benefits

data.title: Senior Creative Concept/Copy (Social) (gn)
data.description:
Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

💡 👉 Hinweis: Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung.

DEINE ROLLE

Wir bauen für einen unserer Hero Accounts eine Creative Unit auf – als Senior Creative Concept/Copy bist du ein elementarer Teil dieses Teams, das mit vollem Fokus die unterschiedlichsten Briefs löst.
Du bist dabei nicht einfach nur Copywriter:in – du lässt Briefs zu Big Ideas und plattformübergreifenden Kampagnen werden und denkst nicht in einzelnen Postings, sondern in kreativen Welten. Social-First-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss: Auch mit einem eher klassischen Kreativ-Background bist du bei uns richtig.

WAS DU MACHST

  • Von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Feinkonzept entwickelst du eigenständig und in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Creative Lead Kampagnen für unseren Hero Account: durchdacht, plattformgerecht und im Idealfall mit Award-Potenzial

  • Du schreibst starke Skripte und Copy für unterschiedlichste Themen und Formate – immer trennscharf innerhalb der jeweiligen Brand-Identity

  • Du bringst deine Ideen eigenständig in überzeugende Präsentationsform und stellst sie sicher vor Kund:innen sowie internen Stakeholdern vor

  • Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Junior- und Mid-Level-Creatives im Team und trägst mit deiner Arbeit aktiv zur kreativen Weiterentwicklung des Accounts und der Creative Unit bei

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Departments innerhalb der Agentur zusammen


WAS DU BRAUCHST

Security Engineer (Remote - Germany)
data.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Key Responsibilities

Application security (the core of the role)

  • Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

  • Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

  • Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

  • Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

  • Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

  • Explain technical risk in plain words to the team and leadership

  • Cover security alerts, including occasional night and weekend on-call

Also part of the role (lighter)

  • Keep a simple risk register and GRC documentation up to date

  • Share security updates with the team and run awareness training

  • Watch emerging AI threats (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass) and incidents at our AI providers

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 2+ years of hands-on security experience

  • Hands-on AppSec, not compliance only: you review code regularly and can walk us through a real vulnerability you found and fixed

  • Audits and pentests: you’ve coordinated an external audit or pentest and followed the findings through to fixes

  • Engineering workflows: you ship code with Git/GitHub, script in Python or Bash, and have recent hands-on work on a modern web stack (e.g. Rails, Node; GCP, Heroku or similar)

  • Ownership with little support: you’ve been the sole or lead security person, or owned a security area on your own. You’ve reviewed code or tested systems every week in the last 2 years, and you explain risk clearly to non-technical people

  • AI in your daily work: you use AI tools every day in your security work

  • A hacker mindset: You love breaking things to make them safer, and security isn’t only your job: you do it for fun too, through bug bounties, CTFs, research, write-ups or your own tools.


Nice-to-haves

  • ⭐ AI/LLM security testing (prompt injection, jailbreaking): a strong plus

  • Experience at an AI company or a scale-up

  • GRC awareness

  • Familiarity with MDM and access management


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €65K – €115K • Multiple Ranges

  • Mid • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €65K – €85K
  • Senior • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) €85K – €115K

data.title: Applied AI Engineer, Large Enterprise
data.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich/Berlin. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

  • Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

  • Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

  • Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

  • Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

  • Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of 5+ years of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

  • Are fluent in both German and English

  • Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

  • Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

  • Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

  • Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

  • Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

  • Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

  • Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

data.title: Security & Privacy Lead
data.description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As Scarlet's first Security & Privacy Lead, you will own how we protect the information our customers trust us with. They share highly sensitive data with us, and keeping it safe is one of our most important responsibilities. Scarlet is growing fast, and our security and privacy programme has to keep up the pace.

You will own our ISO 27001-certified information security management system and our data privacy programme, and make them scale as we grow. You will work closely with engineering to find and fix risks early, and with teammates across Scarlet so that everyone, from new joiners to contractors, has a secure environment that works for them.

You will also shape how Scarlet adopts AI tools safely, assessing the threat vectors of new tools and helping build an internal ecosystem of AI tools that is secure by design.

As a certification body, we hold ourselves to high standards for information security and data privacy. Your work will help us meet them without slowing anyone down.

Responsibilities

  • Own and improve Scarlet's ISO 27001-certified ISMS.

  • Own and improve Scarlet's GDPR-compliant data privacy programme.

  • Be hands-on with implementing and maintaining controls.

  • Perform information security and data privacy risk assessments for vendors and AI tools.

  • Help build Scarlet's internal ecosystem of AI tools, so that it is secure by design and lets colleagues use AI freely and safely.

  • Lead threat modelling with our engineers, commission external penetration tests and drive their findings to resolution.

  • Represent Scarlet's security and privacy to customers.

  • Proactively monitor our systems and operations to spot real vulnerabilities with practical consequences.

Required qualifications

  • Experience owning an ISMS through ISO 27001 certification or surveillance audits.

  • Experience running a GDPR compliance programme.

  • A track record of being hands-on, implementing security controls yourself, not only advising others on them.

  • Evidence of building a programme that scales. You've turned recurring compliance work, such as policy reviews, evidence collection or security questionnaires, into a repeatable process that handles growing volume without a matching increase in manual work.

  • Experience assessing the information security and data privacy risks of third-party services.

  • Experience working with engineers on threat models and penetration test remediation, with the technical judgement to read an architecture and challenge it.

  • Experience explaining technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues and customers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working in a highly regulated environment, such as medical devices or conformity assessment.

  • Experience with SOC 2 or other security attestations.

  • Knowledge of AI regulation and standards, such as the EU AI Act or ISO 42001.

  • Experience administering or securing AI platforms or agent tooling in a business setting.

  • Experience automating compliance work.

The interview process

  1. Intro chat with Niclas - 30 min (remote)

  2. Compliance knowledge chat with Tom - 30 min (remote)

  3. Technical knowledge chat with Alan - 30 min (remote)

data.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Senior Commercial Counsel with substantial experience in consumer-facing technology businesses to join our global Legal & Corporate Affairs team at an exciting period in Trustly's growth. You will be responsible for partnering with our commercial teams to draft, negotiate, and close a wide variety of transactions across the EU and UK. This role will work cross-functionally with product, go-to-market, consumer partnerships, compliance, and operations teams at Trustly to support the sustainable growth of a hyper-scale business across the EU and UK. You will manage multiple simultaneous complex negotiations, requiring the ability to prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

You will be a highly commercial and pragmatic individual who thrives on closing deals and enjoys partnering closely with business teams, to speak with "one voice" to external counterparties whilst launching and scaling products and services. You will possess strong experience working from counterparty's terms and templates, with strong commercial judgment and the ability to efficiently negotiate and close deals whilst protecting Trustly's interests. You will be comfortable pushing back strongly on firm redlines when required - including with internal stakeholders - whilst remaining creative and solutions-oriented when finding paths forward through complex negotiations. You will take pride in being proactive, extremely responsive to the business teams, protecting the business, and enabling innovation through creative legal solutions.

 
 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of large, complex commercial agreements with merchants, partners, and financial institutions, including payment processing agreements, merchant services agreements, API agreement, IP licences, data processing agreements, procurement agreements, and third-party provider (TPP) relationships.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other consumer-facing legal documentation in compliance with EU and UK consumer protection regulations.

  • Demonstrate strong expertise in working from counterparty's terms and templates, efficiently identifying and negotiating key commercial and legal issues to close deals quickly whilst protecting Trustly's interests.

  • Partner with Privacy and Compliance teams to ensure consumer-facing products and services meet data protection and privacy requirements, including consent management, transparency obligations, and data subject rights.

  • Develop and maintain Trustly's standard form agreements, playbooks, and contracting processes to streamline efficiency, maintain compliance, and mitigate risk.

  • Support the launch of new consumer-focused product initiatives in partnership with Product Counsel, coordinating with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure commercial agreements comply with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Provide strategic legal advice on contract interpretation and dispute resolution.

 
 

WHO YOU ARE

  • Law degree (LLB, LLM, or equivalent) and qualified solicitor, barrister, avocat, or equivalent legal qualification in the UK or another EU member state, with experience at a consumer-facing technology business (strong private practice background is required).

  • Strong technical aptitude to quickly understand complex technology products and payment systems, with a proven track record of successfully partnering with Sales and business teams.

  • Comfortable and confident pushing back strongly on firm legal and commercial redlines, including with internal teams, whilst maintaining collaborative relationships and demonstrating creativity and resourcefulness in finding solutions to complex negotiation roadblocks.

  • Proactive, highly responsive, and service-oriented approach to supporting business teams, with genuine enjoyment of closing deals and getting transactions across the line, demonstrating a results-driven mindset and entrepreneurial nature with a bias for action.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating large commercial contracts, consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other legal documentation for digital products and services. Experience in FinTech, payments, or financial services strongly preferred. Experience in gaming is a plus.

  • Knowledge of marketing and advertising regulations, distance selling regulations, and e-commerce requirements.

We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

  2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

A career at Healthtech-1 is unlike any other. It's a career that changes lives. We're excited to hear from you!" -- Rupert, Head of Operations & Finance

💙 A bit about us

💙 We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world.

🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception.

💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

⛵️And of course, an adventure of a lifetime!

🌈 Inclusive & Diverse by Design

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We’re looking for a Benelux Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. You’ll be grounded in our London GTM hub and spend lots of time in the region, getting to know the market up close.

We already have great momentum in Benelux, and our new Benelux Sales Director has joined to lead sales in the region. Now we need someone to support the Benelux hub and get our brand out there, so that when a Benelux finance team outgrows its current setup, Light is the obvious next move.

You’ll own the Benelux marketing plan end to end. You’ll have a dotted line into the Benelux hub, which spans sales, implementation and customer success, and you’ll work closely with our central growth team to find new ways to drive demand through digital channels.

We’re open on level. Whether you’re earlier in your marketing career or have years of experience behind you, we’ll shape the role around the person we hire.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and running the Benelux marketing plan, with pipeline targets you share with the Benelux hub.

  • Running a field and events programme across Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Brussels, Antwerp, Luxembourg and any other city you think makes sense, from intimate CFO dinners to flagship moments people talk about for months.

  • Growing partnerships with the accounting firms, advisors, investors and communities that Benelux finance leaders trust and that extend our voice across the region.

  • Localising our story, content and campaigns so they land with Benelux finance teams in their own language and context.

  • Creating content with our customers, product and design teams that turns what Light does into stories people want to share.

  • Working with our central growth team to test and scale digital demand generation in the region.

  • Building relationships with local press and the people who shape the Benelux tech and finance conversation.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Experience in B2B marketing, ideally at a fast-growing SaaS company, with hands-on time in field, events, partnerships or content.

  • The judgement to know which lever to pull and when, and the drive to learn the ones you haven’t pulled yet.

  • A feel for what lands with Dutch, Belgian and Luxembourgish audiences, and how to localise a brand for each of them.

  • Comfort working with sales, implementation and customer success as one team, with pipeline as the shared goal.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping finance teams and the companies they serve.

  • A great storyteller across video, text and meme.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

  • Fluency in English and Dutch. French is a bonus.

  • A passport. Expect to spend lots of time across Benelux, plus trips to our teams in Copenhagen, Munich, New York and elsewhere.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London, whenever you’re not on the road in Benelux.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 The chance to put Light on the map in Benelux and shape a category from the inside.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

We already have momentum in Benelux, and now we want every scaling company in the region to know our name. If you know the market, love building from the ground up and want to help retire the ERP for good, let’s talk.

data.title: Senior National Account Manager - Industry & Manufacturing
data.description:
The Practical Detail
Location: Southwark, London
Working Model: Hybrid

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. By combining commercial expertise with culinary innovation, you will help manufacturers create exceptional food products that meet evolving consumer needs. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers.

What you'll do

  • Lead the execution of Flora Professional's growth strategy across Industry & Manufacturing sectors, identifying new commercial opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers.
  • Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Technical, and R&D teams to develop innovative recipes and product applications that showcase Flora's portfolio.
  • Drive commercial excellence through negotiations, joint business planning, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements.
  • Manage and coach a Junior Key Account Manager, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

Performance
You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Success will be measured by your ability to meet growth targets, secure new partnerships, and maintain strong sales performance.

Care
This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You will work closely across functions including Marketing, Technical, R&D, Culinary, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure aligned and sustainable commercial execution. Your decisions will balance short-term results with long-term partnerships and responsible business practices that build lasting value for Flora and its customers.

Passion
You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability drives you to help customers develop exceptional products that stand out in the market. You take pride in contributing to Flora Food Group's future-focused approach to better food, inspiring kitchens and consumers alike.

About you
You bring proven experience managing strategic B2B accounts within Foodservice, FMCG, or Industry & Manufacturing, with a strong track record of growing long-term commercial opportunities. You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. Over time, you can expect to take on greater responsibility for shaping strategy and leading larger teams, influencing Flora Food Group's growth across multiple markets.

What's next
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply before: 31-Oct-2026

For questions about the role, please contact:

You take pride in contributing to Flora Food Group's future-focused approach to better food, inspiring kitchens and consumers alike.

About you

You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. data.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP (ECC and S/4HANA) and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments (ECC, S/4HANA) or procurement platforms (Ariba).

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI).

  • Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods, such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI.

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🍽️ Catered lunches & dinners

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

data.title: Senior Engineer - IAM and Workplace Technology
data.description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll join Tech as a Senior Engineer. Tech owns identity and access, IT and workplace technology for the whole company. Today it's a Workplace Tech engineer and an IAM engineer, and you'll be the most senior engineer on the team.

This is a hands-on role. You'll work the access and IT queue with the team, and you'll lead the technical work that shrinks it: the automation, the identity platform and the roadmap. As Primer grows and the team grows with it, there's room for the role to grow too, including into leading the team for the right person.

Tech is an enablement team. It sits alongside Security Engineering, not inside it, and owns the request queue and the tools that keep everyone at Primer productive. Primer is growing fast, and access requests are growing even faster. Our job is to make getting the right access quick, safe and mostly automatic, so people can get on with their work and our security engineers can get back to security.

What you'll be doing

  • Work the IAM, IT and Workplace Tech queue alongside the team, and set the bar for turnaround and quality.

  • Lead the technical roadmap for Tech and deliver it, starting with SCIM day-1 provisioning, Okta, automated access reviews and device enrolment.

  • Automate the routine. Use identity tooling, scripting, workflow automation and AI to take repetitive access requests off people's plates.

  • Run joiner, mover and leaver processes so new starters have what they need on day one and access is removed promptly when it should be.

  • Keep access controls audit-ready. Work with Security and GRC on access reviews, least privilege and evidence for PCI DSS and SOC 2.

  • Partner with Security Engineering on the calls that need them, such as privileged access and policy exceptions, and handle the rest within Tech.

  • Mentor the other engineers on the team, review their work and share what you know.

  • Track and report on how the queue is doing: volume, turnaround, and how much automation is taking off it.

What we're looking for

  • Senior-level experience in IT, IAM or corporate engineering at a fast-growing tech company

  • Hands-on with an identity provider (Okta preferred; Entra ID, Google Workspace or similar also welcome), including SSO, SCIM and lifecycle management

  • A track record of automating manual IT and access work, with scripting, workflow tools or APIs

  • Experience with SaaS administration and endpoint management (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Intune)

  • Good judgement about access: you understand least privilege and know when something needs a security review

  • Experience owning projects end to end and helping others on the team level up

  • Clear, friendly written communication. Much of the job is helping colleagues across the business

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments or another regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

  • Experience running access reviews and providing audit evidence

  • Using AI tools to speed up support and operations work

  • Experience scaling an IT function through a period of fast headcount growth

You may not like it here if...

  • You're looking for a management role. This is a hands-on senior engineering role.

  • You'd rather follow an established playbook. A lot of this is being set up for the first time, and you'll be the one defining how it works.

  • You prefer to fix requests one at a time rather than remove the reasons they come in. We measure success by how much of the queue disappears.

  • Shifting priorities frustrate you. We're a growing company and the team's focus will change as we scale.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Flexible holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

data.title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
data.description:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

data.title: Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tools Development Intern
data.description:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Rocket Engine Injector Modelling and Design Tool Development intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role

We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join our Combustion Devices team and contribute to the development of engineering tools supporting the design and analysis of liquid rocket engine injectors.

During this internship, you will work on computational tools to automate and accelerate the preliminary design and assessment of injector configurations.

Your work will focus on three main areas:

  • Injector layout & manifold modelling: develop tools to automate injector element layouts and associated fuel and oxidiser manifolds, based on geometrical, fluid-dynamic and engineering design rules.
  • Injector spray-pattern visualisation: develop a qualitative visualisation of spray/jet directions, cone angles, spatial coverage and interactions between neighbouring injector elements.
  • Face-plate thermal assessment: contribute to a physics-based methodology to assess thermal loads based on injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle, injection conditions and combustion behaviour.


The developed tools will support the team in rapidly comparing injector configurations, identifying potential performance and thermal risks, and improving the overall preliminary design process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing injector design methodologies, engineering rules and relevant technical literature.
  • Develop algorithms for automated injector layout and fuel/oxidiser manifold generation.
  • Implement engineering models and methodologies in MATLAB and Python.
  • Develop an injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • Develop preliminary models to assess injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Use relevant parameters such as injector configuration, local mixture ratio, spray angle and injection/combustion conditions.
  • Define relevant CFD analysis needs and interpret available CFD and experimental data.
  • Validate models and tools against available analytical, numerical, experimental or literature data.
  • Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future development and integration into the Combustion Devices design process.


What you need to be successful

  • Final-year student or recent graduate in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in MATLAB and Python.
  • Good understanding of:
    • Fluid mechanics
    • Thermodynamics and heat transfer
    • Numerical methods and computational modelling
  • Experience with data processing, numerical analysis or scientific computing.
  • Ability to translate physical and engineering requirements into computational models and algorithms.
  • Ability to analyse numerical results and identify relevant physical trends.
  • Critical thinking when assessing modelling assumptions and engineering correlations.
  • Interest in rocket propulsion, combustion devices and liquid-propellant injection systems.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.


Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Autonomous, structured and methodical approach.
  • Curiosity and willingness to explore unfamiliar technical topics.
  • Ability to collaborate within a multicultural and multidisciplinary engineering team.
  • Good technical communication and documentation skills.
  • Attention to detail and critical thinking.


Nice to have

Any of the following would be a plus, but is not required:

  • Experience with liquid rocket engine injectors, combustion chambers or other combustion systems.
  • Knowledge of coaxial, impinging-jet, swirl or pintle injectors.
  • Knowledge of multiphase flows, sprays, atomisation or propellant mixing.
  • Knowledge of combustion physics, reacting flows or turbulent heat transfer.
  • Experience with thermal modelling or heat-transfer correlations.
  • Experience with CFD tools, post-processing or interpretation of reacting-flow/heat-transfer simulations.
  • Experience analysing parameters such as local mixture ratio, spray angle, wall heat flux or wall temperature.
  • Experience developing engineering correlations from numerical or experimental data.
  • Experience with geometrical algorithms, optimisation or automated engineering design tools.
  • Experience developing graphical interfaces or engineering visualisation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.


Expected internship outcomes

By the end of the internship, you will have contributed to:

  • A functional MATLAB/Python tool for automated injector layout and manifold definition.
  • An injector spray-pattern visualisation tool.
  • A preliminary physics-based methodology for assessing injector face-plate thermal loads.
  • Validation of the developed methodologies against available literature, CFD, experimental or reference data.
  • Technical documentation covering the tools, methodologies, assumptions, limitations and recommendations for future integration.


Supervision and collaboration

You will be supervised by an engineer from the Combustion Devices team and collaborate closely with the future users of the tools. Technical priorities, verification cases and acceptance criteria will be reviewed regularly to ensure that the tools address practical engineering needs.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. data.title: Technical Account Manager

Account Management Lead - Editions France
data.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!
